installdir/readAcfInstalldir/coercion.divergenceNote: @node-steam/vdf coerced the numeric-looking installdir 1e3 to a number which the oracle rejected as non-string; Rust keeps the on-disk string, which is what Steam wrote.

installdir/readAcfInstalldir/comments-un.divergenceNote: The oracle returned nothing for this manifest with comments and unquoted tokens; the Rust parser reads it.

installdir/readAcfInstalldir/escapes.divergenceNote: The oracle returned the escape sequence verbatim (two backslashes); the Rust parser decodes the escape to one backslash, as Steam does. sanitizeInstalldir still rejects separators.

installdir/readAcfInstalldir/lowercase-k.divergenceNote: Steam KeyValues lookups are case-insensitive; the oracle missed a lowercase appstate/installdir while the Rust reader finds it.

installdir/readAcfInstalldir/truncated.divergenceNote: The oracle's @node-steam/vdf parse never terminates on a truncated manifest; Rust fails soft and the wrapper returns undefined.
